pressure_strata: Within-class median human_activity; low <= median, high > median
sampling: SRS blocks without replacement within each class-pressure stratum; one uniform pixel per selected block
purpose: Ground verification of numeric land-cover classes and survey feasibility; no guaranteed bird sightings
scope: Candidate city AOI intersect frozen common domain, valid LULC and human_activity; missing-data areas excluded and counted
primary_response: Visit-level detection/non-detection of the reviewed waterbird target community within a recorded survey footprint
secondary_responses: Recorded richness under complete target checklist
historical_response_admission: No automatic zero filling, effort correction, independent-label conversion or InVEST H_j estimation
protocol_numbers_basis: Operational starting design, not validated optimal effort or closure assumption; revise after feasibility pilot before formal registration
inferential_limits: Pixel centers are land-cover inspection targets; observers choose and record legal accessible viewpoints separately
The observed footprint, not a checklist centroid or pixel code, defines bird-response spatial support
Pressure strata are covariate contrasts and do not establish accessibility
Nearby blocks, different strata in the same block and seasonal repeats are not independent replicates
Initial inclusion probabilities do not survive unrecorded replacement or conditioning on observed birds
Pilot size is an operational coverage allocation, not statistical power
Future responses are not strict end-to-end OOF gate targets while upstream screening lineage remains unresolved
